assertion_results.text: Bug parsing correctly extracts all four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) using the heading formats from bug-template-mock.md (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 54-61 show a Section Coverage table confirming all four required sections are present with their heading formats (`### **Issue Description**`, `### **Steps to Reproduce**`, `### **Expected Result**`, `### **Actual Result**`). Line 63 confirms: 'All four required sections (Description, Steps to Reproduce, Expected Result, Actual Result) are present and well-formed.'

assertion_results.text: Bug validation confirms the issue type ID (10020) matches the Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration (Step 1)
assertion_results.evidence: bug-parsing.md lines 15-17: 'Bug issue type ID from issue: **10020**', 'Bug issue type ID from Bug Configuration: **10020**', '**Match confirmed** -- issue type is valid Bug.'

assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies the trailing-whitespace heading extraction as the root cause — line[3:] does not strip whitespace (Steps 2-3)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md lines 22-23: 'The heading extraction at `line[3:]` does NOT strip trailing whitespace. When a heading line is `## Migration Patterns  \n`, the extracted section name becomes `"Migration Patterns  "` (with two trailing spaces). This is the direct cause of the bug.'

assertion_results.text: Root cause comment includes: what is broken (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace), where it is broken (plan-feature convention lookup), and how to verify the fix (reproducer test with whitespace in heading) (Step 4)
assertion_results.evidence: root-cause.md has three sections: 'What is broken' (heading extraction does not strip trailing whitespace from `line[3:]`), 'Where it is broken' (plan-feature convention lookup in `plugins/sdlc-workflow/skills/plan-feature/SKILL.md`), and 'How to verify the fix' (reproducer test with trailing whitespace on heading lines, assert convention reference appears). Footer attribution included.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST acceptance criterion — before any fix criteria (Step 5 Acceptance Criteria ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 31 (first acceptance criterion): '- [ ] Reproducer test: a test with a `CONVENTIONS.md` fixture containing trailing whitespace on heading lines confirms the convention is correctly matched and included in the generated task output'. Fix criteria follow on lines 32-34.

assertion_results.text: Task description has reproducer test as the FIRST test requirement — with explicit assertion guidance derived from the Steps to Reproduce (Step 5 Test Requirements ordering)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md line 37 (first test requirement): 'Reproducer test: create or extend a plan-feature eval with a `CONVENTIONS.md` fixture that includes trailing whitespace on at least one heading (e.g., `## Migration Patterns  ` with trailing spaces); assert that the generated task\'s Implementation Notes contain the expected convention reference (`Per CONVENTIONS.md Migration Patterns:`)'. Assertion guidance is derived from the Steps to Reproduce scenario.

assertion_results.text: Task description includes a Bug Context section with Bug key (ACME-500), Steps to Reproduce, Expected/Actual Result, and Root Cause summary (Step 5 Bug Context extension)
assertion_results.evidence: task-description.md lines 18-25 contain '## Bug Context' with: Bug key '[ACME-500](https://mock-jira.example.com/browse/ACME-500)', Steps to Reproduce (create CONVENTIONS.md with trailing whitespace, run /plan-feature), Expected Result (Implementation Notes include convention), Actual Result (convention silently dropped), and Root Cause (line[3:] without stripping trailing whitespace).
